scope: Publication of reviewed records on this Atlas Site only; never a scientific execution date, source record creation date, or latest site deployment date.

canonical_hash.serialization: Compact JSON, no whitespace, no ASCII escaping. Top-level insertion order question, answers, method, result; language insertion order pt-BR, en.

v9.timestamp_source: updated_at on the succeeded publish deployment record

v10.timestamp_source: updated_at on the succeeded publish deployment record

v15.timestamp_source: updated_at on the succeeded publish deployment record

limitations: Deployment timestamp comes from updated_at on a succeeded publish record; the API does not expose a separate first-request timestamp.
Eight duplicate legacy records cannot be individually distinguished without stable public record identity; published_at is deliberately null.
Indexes are audit locators only. The matching algorithm uses content equality, not array position.
All complete v10 records already existed verbatim in v9. The v15 editorial revision preserved all scientific results and answer scopes.
updated_at represents when current four-field public content first appeared on a successful published version, not every site redeployment.
